Package index

Package overview

High-level map of inputs, workflows, measurement boundaries, and citations.

ldfreq ldfreq-package
Reproducible Lexical Diversity and Frequency Profiles

Core lexical-diversity metrics

Compute eleven default lexical-diversity measures, moving-average MTLD, and experimental expected-TTR D from pre-tokenized word vectors.

lexdiv_metric_ids() lexdiv_metrics() lexdiv_metrics_batch() print(<lexdiv_batch_results>) print(<lexdiv_results>)
Compute Versioned Lexical-Diversity Metric Variants
lexdiv_variant_metrics() print(<lexdiv_variant_results>)
Explicit Maas and Sequential-MTLD Comparison Variants

Raw text, tokenization, and word units

Tokenize raw English texts, attach lemma or AntBNC flemma layers, bridge raw texts into corpus annotations, or import Japanese/external annotations.

lexdiv_tokenize() lexdiv_lemmatize() lexdiv_lemmatize_batch() lexdiv_metrics_text() print(<lexdiv_tokenization>) print(<lexdiv_text_results>)
Versioned Raw-Text Preprocessing for Lexical-Diversity Metrics
lexdiv_tokenize_batch() lexdiv_metrics_text_batch() print(<lexdiv_text_batch_results>) plot(<lexdiv_text_batch_results>)
Tokenize and Analyze Multiple Texts with Explicit Document IDs
lexdiv_flemmatize() lexdiv_flemmatize_batch()
Add Flemmas from a Caller-Supplied AntBNC Lemma List
lexdiv_import_annotations() lexdiv_as_annotations() print(<lexdiv_annotations>)
Import External Annotations or Bridge Raw Texts to Corpus Annotations
lexdiv_family_profile()
Count resource-defined word families while retaining source occurrences
lexdiv_read_masc() lexdiv_as_quanteda()
Read local MASC Penn annotations and retain positions in quanteda

Plans, local MATTR trajectories, and token-floor screens

Define multi-parameter measurement plans, inspect window-by-window MATTR profiles, and evaluate empirical token-count floors without altering scores.

lexdiv_spec() lexdiv_grid() lexdiv_plan() lexdiv_methods() lexdiv_presets() print(<lexdiv_spec>) print(<lexdiv_grid>) print(<lexdiv_plan>) print(<lexdiv_profile_results>) print(<lexdiv_profile_batch_results>)
Build Explicit Lexical-Diversity Method Plans
lexdiv_mattr_profile() print(<lexdiv_mattr_profile>)
Inspect the local MATTR trajectory and positional exposure
plot(<lexdiv_mattr_profile>)
Plot one local MATTR trajectory
lexdiv_screen_lengths()
Evaluate Independent Token-Count Screens Without Modifying Metric Values
lexdiv_length_evidence()
Inspect Context-Specific Token-Length Evidence

Recipes, portable records, and reporting

Reuse resolved settings, inspect differences, and export results or calculation descriptions without changing the measurement engine.

lexdiv_recipe() print(<lexdiv_recipe>)
Reusable raw-text analysis recipes
lexdiv_run_recipe() print(<lexdiv_analysis>)
Run a saved recipe through the R calculation APIs
lexdiv_write() lexdiv_read()
Save and read portable recipes and analysis records
lexdiv_compare_analyses()
Inspect differences between saved analysis conditions
lexdiv_methods_text()
Describe saved calculations in English or Japanese

Reference-vocabulary and morphology profiles

Inspect license terms, download SHA-256-verified optional datasets, and profile vocabulary with TUBELEX, New JACET 8000, BNC/COCA, MorphoLex, or MorphyNet.

lexdiv_resource_info() lexdiv_download_resources()
Inspect and explicitly download optional reference data
tubelex_profile() tubelex_profile_batch() print(<tubelex_profile>) print(<tubelex_profile_batch>) plot(<tubelex_profile_batch>)
Coverage-Aware TUBELEX Frequency and Prevalence Profile
tubelex_diagnostics()
Tabulate TUBELEX profiles while retaining coverage and input conditions
nj8_profile() nj8_profile_batch() print(<lexical_level_profile>) print(<nj8_profile_batch>) plot(<lexical_level_profile>)
Profile lexical coverage by New JACET 8000 frequency level
nj8_diagnostics()
Diagnose NJ8 non-matches and lexical-unit transformations
bnccoca_data()
Read Nation's BNC/COCA Level 6 Word-Family Lists
morpholex_data()
Read the Cached MorphoLex English Database
morphynet_read_derivations()
Read MorphyNet Derivational Relations from a Local File

Custom lexical norms, overlap, and n-grams

Apply your own familiarity/AoA/frequency tables, measure exact lexical overlap or set coverage, and build or compare adjacent n-gram references.

lexdiv_norm_profile() lexdiv_norm_spec() lexdiv_resource_meta() print(<lexdiv_norm_profile>)
Profile Terms with Caller-Supplied Lexical Norms
lexdiv_norm_profile_batch() print(<lexdiv_norm_profile_batch>)
Apply Caller-Supplied Lexical Norms to Multiple Documents
lexdiv_overlap_ids() lexdiv_term_overlap() lexdiv_content_overlap() print(<lexdiv_overlap>)
Compute Exact Type Overlap Between Two Texts
lexdiv_reference_coverage() print(<lexdiv_reference_coverage>) plot(<lexdiv_reference_coverage>)
Compute Coverage of Multiple Documents by One Reference Term Set
lexdiv_ngrams() lexdiv_ngram_reference() lexdiv_ngram_profile() print(<lexdiv_ngrams>) print(<lexdiv_ngram_reference>) print(<lexdiv_ngram_profile>)
Adjacent Bigrams and Trigrams with Local Reference Frequencies
lexdiv_build_ngram_reference() print(<lexdiv_ngram_build>)
Build an N-gram Reference from Whole-Document Chunks
lexdiv_compare_ngrams() print(<lexdiv_ngram_comparison>)
Compare N-gram References on the Same Target Items

Study tables and source-linked corpus exploration

Prepare longitudinal mixed-model tables, search KWIC concordances, and compute within-document dispersion, collocations, keyness, or response pairs.

lexdiv_study_table() lexdiv_study_model_data() print(<lexdiv_study_model_data>)
Join Planned Observations to Saved Measurements and Select Model Rows
lexdiv_concordance() lexdiv_sort_concordance() lexdiv_concordance_dispersion() print(<lexdiv_concordance>) print(<lexdiv_dispersion>) plot(<lexdiv_concordance>)
Search Source-Aligned Words and Phrases and Inspect Their Distribution
lexdiv_collocations()
Count collocation opportunities and descriptive association scores
lexdiv_keyness() lexdiv_keyness_concordance()
Compare word frequencies in explicit target and reference corpora
lexdiv_compare_responses()
Compare paired binary vocabulary responses with an explicit criterion

Annotation review, alignment, and contextual models

Audit changed tags, align different segmentations, record human KWIC disambiguation decisions, and evaluate external contextual model proposals.

lexdiv_compare_annotations()
Compare annotation versions on identical tokenized documents
lexdiv_evaluate_annotations()
Evaluate external annotation labels against an explicit reference
lexdiv_align_annotations()
Align different token segmentations using original source positions
lexdiv_ambiguity_review()
Review lexical candidates in their original contexts
lexdiv_compare_ambiguity()
Compare two contextual lexical-candidate reviews
lexdiv_import_contextual()
Attach external model outputs to verified contextual occurrences
lexdiv_evaluate_contextual()
Compare contextual candidate scores with an explicit reference review
lexdiv_score_contextual()
Score contextual candidates using separate labeled training examples
lexdiv_amod_pairs()
Extract source-linked adjective and common-noun dependency pairs

Reshaping, container conversion, and plotting

Convert tidy or quanteda token containers, reshape long results to wide reporting tables, and draw publication-ready Base-R figures.

lexdiv_as_documents()
Convert Token Containers to Named Documents
lexdiv_widen() print(<lexdiv_wide_results>)
Reshape metric results without recomputing values
plot(<lexdiv_results>) plot(<lexdiv_batch_results>) plot(<lexdiv_profile_results>) plot(<lexdiv_profile_batch_results>) plot(<lexdiv_text_results>) plot(<lexdiv_screen_results>) plot(<tubelex_profile>)
Plot one metric, a length screen or TUBELEX coverage
lexdiv_convenience
Prepare and display lexical-diversity results
